Free Wedding RSVP: A Private Link for Every Guest

Skip the RSVP spreadsheet. Each household gets its own private link to accept or decline, name everyone coming, choose a meal and note allergies. No account needed. You see who's coming and who hasn't replied, and you can send polite reminders in one click. Free for couples.

Try it free: https://bridalteam.com/wedding-rsvp?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-11&utm_content=2026-11-15-noon-wedding-rsvp
